aka.zh: 塔里木沙漠公路（轮台至民丰）

tagline.en: From the Mongolian border in the Altai, through Ürümqi, straight across the Taklamakan desert and up on to the Tibetan plateau, to the Nepalese border at Gyirong
tagline.zh: 从阿尔泰山的中蒙边境出发，经乌鲁木齐，纵穿塔克拉玛干沙漠，登上青藏高原，直到中尼边境的吉隆

start.en: Hongshanzui port on the Mongolian border, Fuhai county, Altay, Xinjiang
start.zh: 新疆阿勒泰地区福海县红山嘴口岸（中蒙边境）

end.en: Gyirong port on the Nepalese border, Gyirong county, Tibet
end.zh: 西藏吉隆县吉隆口岸（中尼边境）

en: G216 crosses western China from north to south, from Hongshanzui on the Mongolian border in the Altai to Gyirong on the Nepalese border. The Ngari tourism office gives its length as more than 3,000 km. It runs south through Fuyun and the Junggar basin to Ürümqi, crosses the Tian Shan to Balguntay, then follows G218 to Korla and G314 to Luntai, crosses the Taklamakan desert to Minfeng, climbs the Kunlun on to the Tibetan plateau and crosses the Changtang to Gaize and Coqên, and from Saga follows G219 to the border at Gyirong.

Until 2013 the road ended at Balguntay south of Ürümqi; the 2013 plan extended it across the desert and the plateau to Nepal. The stretch from Fuyun to Ürümqi is Asian Highway AH4. The atlas draws the route as one piece.
zh: G216 自北向南纵贯中国西部，从阿尔泰山中蒙边境的红山嘴到中尼边境的吉隆。据阿里地区旅游部门，全长 3000 余公里。道路经富蕴、准噶尔盆地南下到乌鲁木齐，翻越天山到巴仑台，随后与 G218 共线到库尔勒、与 G314 共线到轮台，纵穿塔克拉玛干沙漠到民丰，翻越昆仑山登上青藏高原，横穿羌塘到改则、措勤，自萨嘎起与 G219 共线到吉隆边境。
2013 年以前路线止于乌鲁木齐以南的巴仑台；2013 年规划把它延伸，穿过沙漠和高原直达尼泊尔边境。富蕴至乌鲁木齐段是亚洲公路 4 号线。本图集将其绘为一段。

en: The Tarim Desert Highway, built from March 1993 to September 1995, crosses the Taklamakan from north to south: by Xinhua and the central government site, 522 km long, of which 446 km are in shifting dunes. It cut more than 1,000 km off the journey from Minfeng to Ürümqi. The Xinjiang forestry department gives 552 km, and Baidu Baike, a weak source, 565.66 km.

South of Minfeng the road to Gaize, some 800 km long, climbs from below 1,400 m to more than 5,200 m within about 260 km. The Ngari tourism office warns that about 310 km have no mobile signal and that two fuel stations are 550 km apart; 28 base stations were added in September 2025. In the north, a stretch of about 39 km at Yanqi in Xinjiang dates from 1978 and was rebuilt in 2008.
zh: 塔里木沙漠公路 1993 年 3 月至 1995 年 9 月修建，自北向南纵穿塔克拉玛干沙漠：据新华社和中国政府网，全长 522 公里，其中流动沙漠段 446 公里。它使民丰到乌鲁木齐的路程缩短 1000 多公里。新疆维吾尔自治区林业和草原局记为 552 公里，百度百科（弱来源）记为 565.66 公里。
民丰以南至改则约 800 公里，在约 260 公里内从海拔 1400 米以下爬升到 5200 米以上。阿里地区旅游部门提醒，约 310 公里路段没有手机信号，两座加油站相距 550 公里；2025 年 9 月沿线新建 28 座基站。北段焉耆境内约 39 公里路段 1978 年修建，2008 年改建。

en: The northern road from the Altai to Ürümqi and over the Tian Shan is the old G216, which ended at Balguntay. The Tarim Desert Highway was opened on 4 October 1995 and became part of G216 under the 2013 plan (Baidu Baike gives 2014 for the change, a weak source).

The new road from Minfeng over the Kunlun to Gaize, the 'Xinjiang–Tibet line 2', was begun in the Tibet section in April 2018 and in the Xinjiang section in March 2019 (Baidu Baike, weak), and opened in 2023 (Xinhua). At the southern end, on 26 August 2026 a debris flow set off by a glacier collapse in Nepal swept across the border at Gyirong port and destroyed about 3 km of G216; the road reopened on 2 September 2026 (Xinhua).
zh: 从阿尔泰山到乌鲁木齐、再翻越天山的北段是原 G216，止于巴仑台。塔里木沙漠公路 1995 年 10 月 4 日通车，按 2013 年规划并入 G216（百度百科称 2014 年，为弱来源）。
从民丰翻越昆仑山到改则的新路，即“新藏二线”，西藏段 2018 年 4 月开工、新疆段 2019 年 3 月开工（据百度百科，为弱来源），2023 年通车（新华社）。南端，2026 年 8 月 26 日，尼泊尔境内冰川垮塌引发的泥石流越境冲击吉隆口岸，冲毁 G216 约 3 公里；道路于 2026 年 9 月 2 日恢复通行（新华社）。

en: No cost exists for the whole route; each section is priced separately. The Tarim Desert Highway cost 594 million yuan according to Baidu Baike, a figure not checked against an official one. In Tibet, the Dongco–Coqên stretch of G216 was built with the Dongco–Gaize section of G317 for 1.43 billion yuan, more than 250 km in all (Tibet government).
zh: 全线没有总造价，各段分别计价。塔里木沙漠公路据百度百科投资 5.94 亿元，该数字未与官方资料核对。西藏境内，G216 东措至措勤段与 G317 东措至改则段一并建设，共 250 余公里，投资 14.3 亿元（西藏自治区政府）。

why.en: No cost exists for the whole route: it joins the old Altai–Tian Shan road, the 1995 desert highway and the plateau road opened in 2023, each priced separately. See the section figures below.
why.zh: 全线没有总造价：路线连接原阿尔泰—天山公路、1995 年的沙漠公路和 2023 年通车的高原公路，各自单独计价。见下方各段数字。

why.en: No route-wide funding statement exists, and none was found for the individual sections.
why.zh: 未见全线出资说明，也未见各段的出资说明。

value.en: More than 3,000 km. A news portal gives 3,525 km: reported at 3,525 km; not checked against an official source.
value.zh: 3000 余公里。一家门户网站记 3525 公里；该数字未与官方资料核对。

figures.source: Ngari Prefecture tourism, via Tibet Autonomous Region Department of Culture and Tourism, 2025; 163.com (weak)

value.en: 522 km, of which 446 km in shifting dunes; opened 4 October 1995. Other figures: 552 km (Xinjiang forestry department), 565.66 km (Baidu Baike).
value.zh: 522 公里，其中流动沙漠段 446 公里；1995 年 10 月 4 日通车。另有 552 公里（新疆林草局）、565.66 公里（百度百科）之说。

value.en: Reported at 594 million yuan; not checked against an official source.
value.zh: 据报道 5.94 亿元；未与官方资料核对。

figures.source: Baidu Baike, 塔里木沙漠公路 (weak)

label.zh: G216 东措至措勤段及 G317 东措至改则段（250 余公里）

value.en: About 3 km of road destroyed on 26 August 2026; reopened 2 September 2026
value.zh: 2026 年 8 月 26 日冲毁道路约 3 公里；9 月 2 日恢复通行

figures.source: Xinhua; State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC)

timeline.en: A road is built at Yanqi on the line of the later G216.
timeline.zh: 焉耆境内修建后来属于 G216 的路段。

timeline.en: Work begins on the Tarim Desert Highway in March.
timeline.zh: 3 月，塔里木沙漠公路开工。

timeline.en: The Tarim Desert Highway opens on 4 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 4 日，塔里木沙漠公路通车。

timeline.en: The national road plan extends G216 from Balguntay to Gyirong.
timeline.zh: 国道网规划把 G216 由巴仑台延伸到吉隆。

timeline.en: Work begins on the Tibet section of the Minfeng–Gaize road in April.
timeline.zh: 4 月，民丰至改则公路西藏段开工。

timeline.en: 28 mobile base stations are added along the Minfeng–Gaize road in September.
timeline.zh: 9 月，民丰至改则公路沿线新建 28 座基站。

timeline.en: A cross-border debris flow destroys about 3 km of the road at Gyirong on 26 August; it reopens on 2 September.
timeline.zh: 8 月 26 日，跨境泥石流冲毁吉隆段道路约 3 公里；9 月 2 日恢复通行。
